notes.title: RetroMaze Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
[u][b]The game is now running in the most recent GMS2 engine version 2.3[/b][/u]

- Performance improvements in general, specially on older systems.
- Significantly reduced storage needed (From 44.5mb to 13.4mb).
- QoL improvements, including "disco ball" (character) movement.

notes.title: RetroMaze is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662075/d9089c6df470dd1b85cb1df82b9fb271293c2c71.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, RetroGamers![/h1]

We are very happy to announce that [b]RetroMaze[/b] is now available on [b]Steam[/b] and we look forward to know your opinion about the game.

There are plans to add beautiful emoticons, backgrounds and trading cards, but according to the new rules of the valve, for this to be possible we need to reach a certain number of reviews and sales, so don't forget to leave your review, that is very important for us.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662075/85db214eb2cae34208aba93aaf546f42a8083861.png[/img]
